```python
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd

def extract_precipitation_data(year):
    url = f"https://www.wunderground.com/history/monthly/us/wa/seattle/KSEA/date/{year}-9"
    response = requests.get(url)
    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, 'html.parser')
    
    # Locate the table containing daily weather data
    table = soup.find('table', {'class': 'days'})
    rows = table.find_all('tr')
    
    # Extract precipitation data for the first week of September
    precipitation_data = []
    for row in rows[1:8]:  # First week of September
        cols = row.find_all('td')
        precipitation = cols[3].text.strip()  # Assuming precipitation is in the 4th column
        precipitation_data.append(float(precipitation) if precipitation else 0.0)
    
    return precipitation_data

# Collect data for each year
years = [2020, 2021, 2022, 2023]
all_precipitation_data = []

for year in years:
    data = extract_precipitation_data(year)
    all_precipitation_data.extend(data)

# Analyze data
rainy_days = sum(1 for p in all_precipitation_data if p >= 0.5)
total_days = len(all_precipitation_data)
probability = (rainy_days / total_days) * 100

print(f"Probability of hitting a rainy day: {probability:.2f}%")
```
